text:
sienna: Moving out Friday. Free curbside pickup: solid oak 5-shelf bookcase (~72in x 30in), sturdy but heavy, and 2 SF Giants tix (sec 118) I cant take with me. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/example

morgan: Ohhh love the bookcase. Any chance it fits through a standard door? :thinking_face:

sienna: Yes, its in two pieces (shelves removable). No major damage, just a small scuff on the back.

ben: Interested in the game tickets if theyre still available. Date?

sienna: Game is June 10, 7pm. First come first served.

alex: Ill take the bookcase if no other takers. I have a friend with a van and a dolly. Can do Fri morning.

jules: I can help carry stairs if needed (SOMA resident).

morgan: tagging @alex re: dimensions - i measured a similar one and it needed to be tilted to clear the stairwell. good to have two extra hands.

alex: good call. @jules awesome, thanks. sienna what time on Friday works? I can do 9-11 or 5-7pm.

sienna: 9:30am Friday works best. Address: 456 3rd St (SOMA), loading dock C. Ill put a note on the door and leave lights on.

office-bot: Calendar event created: "Pickup - Oak Bookcase" Fri 9:30am (2 attendees).

ben: Tickets sound great, DMing now for transfer details. :baseball:

sienna: Tickets go to ben then, bookcase reserved for alex + jules. If anything changes Ill update this thread.

morgan: yay! thanks for doing this instead of tossing it. photos after move? :smile:

sienna: will post a pic of the bookcase once its out the door, and maybe a selfie at the game if ben sends one. :)
